about: Namesakes split by hand: the tree joins people by name, so these are kept apart section by section (see annotate/merge.py, apply_namesakes).

groups.name: Triton
groups.about: Sea god, son of Poseidon, who appears and guides the Argo out of the Libyan lake; the profile's Wikipedia match (Greek god, messenger of the sea) fits him.

groups.name: Phoreys, father of Scylla
groups.about: Old sea god Phorcys, named only as the father of the monster Scylla.
